description: This file is a PHP script that generates a web page for configuring RIP routing settings. It includes PHP code for data retrieval, embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior, and HTML for the form layout.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Initializes form fields with data from the RIP entry object.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for authentication type selection to enable or disable input fields accordingly.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends the RIP configuration data via AJAX to the server for saving.
